declaration: Publish these exact bytes before dedicated activity acquisition. Preserve this plan and every attempt; outcomes use separate artifacts.

source.admission: Endpoint/column definition qualified for necessary private label-capacity inspection only. Complete experimental material, molecular correspondence, interference and cohort eligibility remain conditional; no accepted receptor/cohort or score.

endpoint.meaning: Reported isolated-BD1 peptide-displacement potency under this assay's conditions; neither KD/Ki nor cellular potency, general inactivity or proven target engagement.
endpoint.primary_source_location: Biological Evaluation Example1 and Table24 BRD4 column/legend, separate from Raji/HL60/H460 columns.

result_fields.unit_authority: The received TID3 descriptor explicitly states micromolar. Do not interpret numeric source-unit enum6 or interchange raw TID5 IC50 values without qualified conversion.

labels.rationale: Use original patent A versus C bins, separated by more than tenfold; retain B as intermediate. Selected after method/legend and the documented incidental exposures, before any class-frequency projection or dedicated activity acquisition. No performance or favorable-count tuning.
labels.interval_rule: Accept finite strictly positive IC50 values only. Interpret relation as an interval over positive potency. Strong requires the complete interval within (0,0.5]; weak requires the complete interval within (5,infinity). Never replace a censored interval by a point, midpoint or bound equality. Other supported intervals remain intermediate or class-ambiguous; retain unsupported, invalid and missing records explicitly.

capacity.unit: At most one eligible group per original SID. Numeric identifiers do not establish chemical/series independence.
capacity.projection: Retain every row, exact source identifiers and conflicting/duplicate SIDs. A SID with incompatible labels is not promoted to either eligible class. Count raw occurrences and distinct SID label upper bounds separately, with failure/ambiguous denominators.
capacity.stop: If either eligible SID upper bound is below50, this single source cannot meet the design. Do not relax labels, pool another AID or replace unfavorable records. A later source requires a new dated nomination.
capacity.pass_is_not_admission: At least50 raw SIDs/class only permits subsequent MolSysMT identity/scaffold/state/series and exposure admission. No chemical uniqueness, independence, accepted labels or achieved statistical precision follows.

receiving: Require exact AID/version/revision, unchanged descriptor semantics and499 tested SIDs/494 raw CIDs before and after. CSV mapping must uniquely match the declared source fields before projecting labels; unexplained headers/schema/coverage or changed metadata stop receiving. Preserve delivered raw values; do not select a partial favorable prefix. A dated series of observations is not an atomic database snapshot.

rights_and_exposure.activity_rows: Private feasibility receiving only; no raw individual table redistribution authorized by this plan. Publish own aggregate facts, controllers and source identities. Resolve exact source-curation/license version before any later public cohort artifact.

observed_policies.observation: Current info page names CC BY3.0 for staff-curated data and CC BY-SA3.0 for ChEMBL imports.
Resource-authored2024 update states CC BY4.0 for BindingDB-curated data; do not silently reconcile this version difference or infer individual-record curation solely from database name.
NCBI hosting does not establish unrestricted rights to linked/submitted third-party material.

rights_and_exposure.prior_exposure: Whole patent/summary/descriptor retrieval includes chemistry and potency information. Method Example1 IC502.782micromolar, first two Table24 B rows, adjacent synthesis names and unrelated chemistry snippets were actually displayed; no chemical aliases were resolved. Earlier source/ERalpha ledgers persist. No blinded/unseen-holdout claim.
rights_and_exposure.threshold_timing: Source A/B/C legend was read before this declaration; class counts have not been computed or reviewed. This is a prospective capacity projection on an exposed source, not preregistration before all literature exposure.

molecular_boundary: No chemical structure/format parsing, identity/scaffold resolution, sequence correspondence, receptor/ligand preparation or molecular geometry here. These operations remain MolSysMT-owned; use supported tools or precise owning issues. PHMT owns assay interpretation, pharmacophores and study orchestration.
resources: Serial execution; explicit taskset to one allowed destination CPU with verified affinity (CPU19 was the historical source-host choice), CPU quota100%,512MiB/no swap/tasks32/nice19/idle I/O and backend threads1 where enforceable. Record actual limits and any inability to enforce them. Stop/defer under memory pressure; no local high-memory full-suite retry.
